Welcome to the Ashburn Ice House House Selects, the premiere youth recreational hockey program in Northern Virginia.

Players who participated in tryouts and were selected for the team should register here.

The Fall/Winter Select season affords our players an opportunity to make an in house divisional All-Star team. The Selects play extra games and tournaments against outside opponents (this program is an additional cost). The strongest players in each playing level will have the opportunity to experience a light travel hockey schedule that is also very competitive.

Playground on ice is a special type of public skating session for 2-8 year olds to develop a love for skating! This is a great way to introduce young and inexperienced skaters to the ice. Kids can play with rubber duckies, foam hockey pucks, small sticks & nets. An adult chaperone is not required to skate with a child, but they are always welcome to join their kids. One chaperone is included with each child registration. Hard hockey pucks are not permitted.

Our Fast Track program is designed to identify certain skaters who may not be receiving enough instruction in a large group setting based on the skills they already have.
This program is by invitation only and will help guide these identified skaters through a faster paced curriculum.

These drop- in 30 minute classes are for levels Pre-Freeskate through Freeskate 6. These classes allow extra practice for skaters that may be struggling with certain skills in each of these levels. Please check in at the front desk upon arrival.

What is Adaptive Skating?
The U.S. Figure Skating Adaptive Program
offers recreational and competitive avenues
for skaters with physical and intellectual
disabilities to thrive. Through skating and
artistic skill development, skaters will
construct a foundation to build success on and
off the ice. Rinks, programs and clubs offer
Adaptive Skating programs for skaters of all
ages and experiences.
